item.title: Multidimensional molecular strategies for crop photoperiod adaptation and latitudinal expansion- | 作物光周期适应与纬度扩张的多维分子策略-
item.description:
Abstract

The traditional regional distribution of agriculture was historically constrained by crops’ inherent dependence on local environmental cues, particularly photoperiod and temperature. Natural domestication and artificial selection have progressively reduced this dependence on native ecosystems, resulting in a profound restructuring of global agricultural patterns. From the perspective of this global restructuring, this study systematically examines the multidimensional molecular mechanisms underlying photoperiodic adaptive evolution, including population-level point mutations, epigenetic modifications, structural variations, and copy number variations. In parallel, we propose that the latitudinal adaptive expansion of crops represents not merely an ecological niche shift, but a complex evolutionary process driven by coordinated genetic reprogramming across the genome, epigenome, and transcriptome. Consequently, reshaping future agricultural landscapes requires moving beyond the constraints imposed by individual climatic factors and establishing a multidimensional framework that integrates environment, genetic traits, and ecological adaptation. Moreover, rather than focusing solely on the speed of regional expansion, future molecular design should promote the coordinated improvement of broad-spectrum latitudinal adaptability and elite yield-quality traits, thereby securing global food safety and agricultural sustainability.

摘要

农业的传统区域分布历来受到作物对当地环境线索固有依赖的制约，尤其是光周期和温度。自然驯化和人工选择逐步降低了这种对原生生态系统的依赖，导致全球农业格局发生深刻重构。从这一全球重构的视角出发，本研究系统考察了光周期适应性进化背后的多维分子机制，包括群体水平的点突变、表观遗传修饰、结构变异和拷贝数变异。与此同时，我们提出，作物的纬度适应性扩张不仅仅代表生态位转移，而是一个由跨基因组、表观基因组和转录组的协调遗传重编程驱动的复杂进化过程。因此，重塑未来农业景观需要超越单个气候因素施加的限制，并建立一个整合环境、遗传性状和生态适应的多维框架。此外，未来的分子设计不应仅关注区域扩张的速度，而应促进广谱纬度适应性与优良产量品质性状的协同改良，从而保障全球粮食安全和农业可持续性。

item.title: Diffusible signals from Azospirillum brasilense promote rice growth and induce distinct gene expression changes in plant roots | 来自 Azospirillum brasilense 的可扩散信号促进水稻生长并诱导植物根部独特的基因表达变化
item.description:
Abstract

Plants form associations with diverse beneficial microbes, including arbuscular mycorrhizal (AM) fungi, rhizobia, and plant growth-promoting bacteria (PGPB). Research on legume-rhizobia symbiosis (LRS) and AM symbiosis has demonstrated that molecular communication between symbiotic partners is essential for initiating these interactions. Genetic and biochemical studies have further identified both plant and microbial signals, as well as host genetic pathways, that regulate these interactions. However, most studies on plant-PGPB interactions have focused on direct application of PGPB to plant roots, leaving the early signaling mechanisms underlying these interactions poorly understood. In this study, we report that diffusible signals from A. brasilense can promote rice growth without direct contact between bacteria and plant roots, 7 days post-treatment (dpt). Using RNA sequencing, we identified 2,516 differentially expressed genes (DEGs) in rice roots in response to diffusible signals from A. brasilense at 1 dpt. We identified differential expression of genes involved in flavonoid synthesis, defense responses, receptor activity, transcription factors, and hormone pathways. Comparative transcriptomic analysis of rice roots with or without contact with A. brasilense revealed both shared and unique gene expression patterns. We observed upregulation of certain defense-response genes ( PAL , chitinase, thionin), transcription factors (AP2/ERFs, MYBs, WRKYs, and GRAS), and hormone-related (auxin and ethylene) genes without bacterial contact, but downregulation or no differential expression of these genes upon bacterial contact. This pattern suggests that initial induction followed by subsequent suppression of these genes may be crucial for establishing the interaction with A. brasilense. Our transcriptomic analysis also suggests that flavonoids may be required throughout the interaction, whereas nitrate transporters appear to be involved at later stages and likely require contact between plant roots and bacteria. Collectively, our findings reveal that diffusible signals from A. brasilense can promote rice growth and induce distinct gene expression changes in plant roots. These results provide novel insights into the early phase of rice- A. brasilense interaction and highlight the potential for leveraging plant-PGPB signaling mechanisms to enhance crop growth under adverse environmental conditions.

摘要

植物与多种有益微生物形成联合，包括丛枝菌根（AM）真菌、根瘤菌和植物促生细菌（PGPB）。对豆科植物-根瘤菌共生（LRS）和 AM 共生的研究表明，共生伙伴之间的分子交流对于启动这些互作至关重要。遗传学和生化研究进一步鉴定了植物和微生物信号，以及调控这些互作的宿主遗传途径。然而，大多数关于植物-PGPB 互作的研究集中于将 PGPB 直接施用于植物根部，导致这些互作背后的早期信号机制仍知之甚少。在本研究中，我们报道来自 A. brasilense 的可扩散信号可以在细菌与植物根部无直接接触的情况下，于处理后 7 天（dpt）促进水稻生长。利用 RNA 测序，我们在处理后 1 天（1 dpt）鉴定了水稻根中响应 A. brasilense 可扩散信号的 2,516 个差异表达基因（DEGs）。我们鉴定到参与类黄酮合成、防御反应、受体活性、转录因子和激素途径的基因存在差异表达。对与 A. brasilense 接触或不接触的水稻根部进行比较转录组分析，揭示了共有和独特的基因表达模式。我们观察到，在没有细菌接触时，某些防御反应基因（PAL、几丁质酶、thionin）、转录因子（AP2/ERFs、MYBs、WRKYs 和 GRAS）以及激素相关（生长素和乙烯）基因上调，但在细菌接触后这些基因下调或无差异表达。这种模式表明，这些基因先诱导后抑制可能对于建立与 A. brasilense 的互作至关重要。我们的转录组分析还表明，类黄酮可能在整个互作过程中都需要，而硝酸盐转运蛋白似乎参与后期阶段，并且可能需要植物根部与细菌之间的接触。总之，我们的发现揭示来自 A. brasilense 的可扩散信号可以促进水稻生长并诱导植物根部独特的基因表达变化。这些结果为水稻-A. brasilense 互作的早期阶段提供了新的见解，并突出了利用植物-PGPB 信号机制在不利环境条件下增强作物生长的潜力。

item.title: Harnessing genetic variation for grain quality from diverse wheat landraces | 利用来自多样小麦地方品种的遗传变异提升籽粒品质
item.description:
Abstract

Summary The grain quality traits of protein content, grain weight and size are socially and economically important for wheat ( Triticum aestivum ) breeding. Modern wheat germplasm has limited genetic variation for vital traits, including grain quality, underscoring the need to investigate ancestral varieties/landraces for beneficial allelic diversity. Here, we develop a reliable and sensitive single‐seed hyperspectral imaging‐based phenotyping platform to quantify grain protein, weight and size in 827 diverse wheat landraces, achieving improved predictive accuracy ( R 2 = 0.91) vs previous methods. We identified novel genetic variants (or loci) for grain protein content and its heterogeneity between individual grains in a genotype, and grain weight, and validated them through bi‐parental linkage mapping. Many loci we report are rare and absent from modern breeding germplasm. Beneficial haplotypes at these loci improved mean protein content and homogeneity without compromising grain weight; these haplotypes represent valuable genetic variation for agriculture. We identify a stable locus on chromosome 6A contributing to protein heterogeneity within single grains, suggesting homogeneity in protein content could be a selectable trait for breeding. Our findings demonstrate how integration of advanced phenotyping into breeding strategies can harness untapped genetic diversity for grain quality improvement in wheat, providing an opportunity to enhance grain nutritional value.

摘要

蛋白质含量、粒重和籽粒大小等籽粒品质性状对小麦（Triticum aestivum）育种具有社会和经济重要性。现代小麦种质在包括籽粒品质在内的关键性状上遗传变异有限，突显了研究祖先品种/地方品种以寻找有益等位基因多样性的必要性。在此，我们开发了一个可靠且灵敏的基于单粒高光谱成像的表型分析平台，用于量化 827 份多样性小麦地方品种的籽粒蛋白质、粒重和籽粒大小，并较先前方法实现了更高的预测准确性（R² = 0.91）。我们鉴定出与籽粒蛋白质含量及其在同一基因型内不同单粒间的异质性以及粒重相关的新遗传变异（或位点），并通过双亲连锁作图进行了验证。我们报道的许多位点很罕见，且在现代育种种质中缺失。这些位点上的有益单倍型提高了平均蛋白质含量和均匀性，而未牺牲粒重；这些单倍型代表了农业上有价值的遗传变异。我们鉴定出 6A 染色体上贡献单粒内蛋白质异质性的稳定位点，表明蛋白质含量的均匀性可能是育种中可选择的性状。我们的研究结果展示了将先进表型分析整合到育种策略中如何能够利用尚未开发的遗传多样性来改良小麦籽粒品质，为提升籽粒营养价值提供了机会。

item.title: Whole-genome duplication reshapes gene–miRNA regulatory networks underlying improved salt stress tolerance in Medicago sativa | 全基因组复制重塑支撑紫花苜蓿（Medicago sativa）耐盐性提高的基因–miRNA 调控网络
item.description:
Abstract

Abstract Whole-genome duplication (WGD) is a recurrent feature of plant evolution and crop improvement, yet its direct contribution to abiotic stress tolerance remains difficult to disentangle from hybridization effects. Using full-sibling diploid (2x) and neotetraploid (4x) Medicago sativa genotypes generated through bilateral sexual polyploidization, we investigated how WGD alone reshapes physiological performance and gene–miRNA regulatory networks under salt stress. Neotetraploid plants displayed enhanced tolerance to salinity, maintaining higher chlorophyll content, stomatal conductance, and shoot integrity, alongside reduced visual damage compared with diploid siblings. Transcriptome profiling revealed that ploidy level, rather than salt treatment per se, was the dominant driver of gene expression variation. Indeed, WGD resulted in extensive and largely constitutive transcriptional reprogramming, with more than 2,000 differentially expressed genes (DEGs) distinguishing 4x from 2x plants under both control and saline conditions. By contrast, under salt stress, 705 DEGs specifically differentiated tetraploids from diploids and were enriched in receptor-like kinases, phosphorylation pathways, ubiquitin-mediated proteolysis, flavonoid biosynthesis, and WRKY- and MYB-centered regulatory modules. Co-expression network analysis identified salt-associated modules linking signaling and antioxidant pathways with stress-related physiological traits. Small RNA sequencing further showed that WGD reshapes post-transcriptional regulation, with limited salt-induced miRNA changes but the emergence of ploidy-dependent miRNA hubs, including miR2593e and a novel miRNA, targeting signaling and defense-related genes. We hypothesize that WGD establishes a stress-ready regulatory architecture in which coordinated transcriptional and post-transcriptional network rebalancing acts as a buffering system that improves alfalfa physiological performance under salinity, without strong induction of canonical salt-responsive genes.

摘要

全基因组复制（WGD）是植物进化和作物改良中反复出现的特征，但其对非生物胁迫耐受性的直接贡献仍难以与杂交效应区分开来。利用通过双向有性多倍化产生的全同胞二倍体（2x）和新四倍体（4x）紫花苜蓿（Medicago sativa）基因型，我们研究了 WGD 单独如何重塑盐胁迫下的生理表现和基因–miRNA 调控网络。新四倍体植株表现出对盐度的增强耐受性，与二倍体同胞相比，维持了更高的叶绿素含量、气孔导度和地上部完整性，同时视觉损伤减轻。转录组分析显示，倍性水平而非盐处理本身是基因表达变异的主要驱动因素。事实上，WGD 导致了广泛且在很大程度上组成型的转录重编程，在对照和盐渍条件下，有超过 2,000 个差异表达基因（DEGs）将 4x 与 2x 植株区分开来。相比之下，在盐胁迫下，705 个 DEGs 特异性地将四倍体与二倍体区分开来，并富集于受体样激酶、磷酸化途径、泛素介导的蛋白水解、类黄酮生物合成以及以 WRKY 和 MYB 为中心的调控模块。共表达网络分析鉴定出盐相关模块，将信号传导和抗氧化途径与胁迫相关生理性状联系起来。小 RNA 测序进一步表明，WGD 重塑了转录后调控，盐诱导的 miRNA 变化有限，但出现了倍性依赖性 miRNA 枢纽，包括 miR2593e 和一个新型 miRNA，靶向信号传导和防御相关基因。我们假设，WGD 建立了一种胁迫就绪型调控架构，其中协调的转录和转录后网络再平衡充当缓冲系统，在盐渍条件下改善苜蓿的生理表现，而无需强烈诱导经典盐响应基因。

item.title: LoGicAl: Local ancestry and genotype calling uncertainty-aware ancestry-specific allele frequency estimation from admixed samples | LoGicAl：考虑局部祖先和基因型 calling 不确定性的混合样本祖先特异性等位基因频率估计
item.description:
Abstract

Abstract Motivation In admixed groups, it is of interest to estimate allele frequencies of their ancestral contributing populations. These ancestry-specific allele frequencies inform genetic drivers of disease etiologies, facilitate genome-wide association study interpretations, enhance polygenic risk prediction and portability, and provide insights into demographic history. Their estimation leverages inferred locus-specific ancestry background, i.e., local ancestry, generated by tools like RFMix. However, existing estimation methods lose accuracy and incur biases by failing to model uncertainty from upstream local ancestry inference and genotype calling. Results Here, we introduce LoGicAl, a novel likelihood-based method for estimating ancestry-specific allele frequencies from admixed samples, simultaneously accommodating uncertainty from ancestry calling, genotyping, and statistical phasing. We demonstrate that modeling these uncertainties substantially reduces estimation errors, resulting in superior accuracy for both sequence-based and array-based genotyping with different levels of local ancestry inference quality. By integrating an accelerated fixed-point algorithm, LoGicAl achieves high scalability and enhanced computational efficiency compared with existing approaches. Applying LoGicAl to admixed cohorts in the 1000 Genomes Project, we illustrate the benefits of local-ancestry-based allele frequency estimates. Together, LoGicAl contributes to genomic analyses of admixed samples by providing precise and rapid ancestry-specific allele frequency estimates, and to constructing the spatial landscape and dynamics of genetic variations in admixed populations at a finer scale. Availability The LoGicAl software is available at https://github.com/student-jw/LoGicAl.

摘要

动机 在混合群体中，估计其祖先贡献群体的等位基因频率具有重要意义。这些祖先特异性等位基因频率可为疾病病因的遗传驱动因素提供信息，促进全基因组关联研究的解释，增强多基因风险预测及其可移植性，并提供对人口统计学历史的见解。其估计依赖于推断的位点特异性祖先背景，即局部祖先，由 RFMix 等工具生成。然而，现有估计方法未能建模来自上游局部祖先推断和基因型 calling 的不确定性，从而损失准确性并产生偏差。结果 在此，我们介绍 LoGicAl，一种新的基于似然的方法，用于从混合样本中估计祖先特异性等位基因频率，同时考虑来自祖先 calling、基因分型和统计定相的不确定性。我们证明，对这些不确定性建模可大幅减少估计误差，从而在不同质量的局部祖先推断下，对基于序列和基于芯片的基因分型均产生更优的准确性。通过整合加速定点算法，与现有方法相比，LoGicAl 实现了高可扩展性和增强的计算效率。将 LoGicAl 应用于 1000 Genomes Project 中的混合队列，我们展示了基于局部祖先的等位基因频率估计的优势。总之，LoGicAl 通过提供精确且快速的祖先特异性等位基因频率估计，为混合样本的基因组分析做出贡献，并在更精细尺度上构建混合群体中遗传变异的空间景观和动态。可用性 LoGicAl 软件可在 https://github.com/student-jw/LoGicAl 获取。

item.title: Climate drivers of mesophyll conductance: temperature and water deficit alter CO 2 diffusion and leaf anatomy in cotton | 叶肉导度的气候驱动因素：温度和水分亏缺改变棉花中 CO2 扩散和叶片解剖结构
item.description:
Abstract

Summary Mesophyll conductance ( g m ) limits CO 2 delivery to Rubisco, yet its responses to temperature, heat and water deficit are poorly resolved in cotton ( Gossypium hirsutum ). We characterised photosynthetic and g m temperature responses in five Gossypium species, then examined cultivated G. hirsutum and the Australian native Gossypium bickii under combined elevated temperature and soil water deficit to link physiological responses with mesophyll anatomy. Plants were grown under controlled glasshouse conditions. We quantified g m using simultaneous gas exchange and online stable carbon isotope discrimination (Δ, ‰) and measured leaf anatomy. Across species, photosynthesis and g m exhibited broad thermal optima (33–36°C). In G. hirsutum , water deficit at control temperature reduced g m and induced thicker, more porous mesophyll and thicker cell walls, while assimilation declined only under combined heat and water deficit. In G. bickii , g m and assimilation remained stable under combined stress, and g m was stimulated by elevated temperature without anatomical adjustment. g m emerged as a stress‐sensitive trait in cultivated cotton, whereas G. bickii exhibited stress resilience, with responses incompletely explained by anatomical acclimation. Further research on g m responses to environmental stresses and on the mechanisms underpinning these responses is required to inform model development and identify traits for climate resilient crops.

摘要

叶肉导度（g m）限制 CO2 向 Rubisco 的输送，但其对温度、高温和水分亏缺的响应在棉花（Gossypium hirsutum）中尚不清楚。我们表征了五个 Gossypium 物种的光合作用和 g m 温度响应，然后考察了栽培种 G. hirsutum 和澳大利亚本土种 Gossypium bickii 在升高的温度和土壤水分亏缺联合条件下的表现，以将生理响应与叶肉解剖结构联系起来。植物在受控温室条件下生长。我们使用同步气体交换和在线稳定碳同位素判别（Δ，‰）量化了 g m，并测量了叶片解剖结构。在物种间，光合作用和 g m 表现出宽的热最适范围（33–36°C）。在 G. hirsutum 中，对照温度下的水分亏缺降低了 g m，并诱导更厚、更多孔的叶肉和更厚的细胞壁，而同化作用仅在高温和水分亏缺联合条件下下降。在 G. bickii 中，g m 和同化作用在联合胁迫下保持稳定，并且 g m 在升高的温度下被刺激，而没有解剖结构上的调整。g m 在栽培棉花中表现为胁迫敏感性状，而 G. bickii 表现出胁迫恢复力，其响应不能完全由解剖驯化解释。需要进一步研究 g m 对环境胁迫的响应以及这些响应背后的机制，以指导模型开发并识别气候适应型作物的性状。

item.title: Single-Cell and Spatial Perspectives on Source-Sink Dynamics in Plants | 植物中源-库动态的单细胞与空间视角
item.description:
Abstract

Abstract Source-sink relationships describe how plants coordinate carbon production, transport, and utilization to support growth, reproduction, and stress responses. Classical physiological studies established a robust organ-level framework for carbon allocation, but these approaches largely treat tissues as homogeneous units. Recent advances in single-cell and spatial omics technologies now reveal that both sources and sinks consist of diverse cell populations with specialized metabolic and transport functions. In this review, we synthesize emerging insights from single-cell transcriptomics, spatial transcriptomics, and integrative multi-omics to show how cellular heterogeneity shapes photosynthetic source strength, vascular transport interfaces, and sink development. We further discuss how stress responses, signaling molecules, and plant-associated microbiomes dynamically reprogram source-sink relationships in a spatially structured manner. Finally, we highlight opportunities to integrate high-resolution molecular atlases with physiological modeling and machine learning approaches to develop predictive frameworks for carbon allocation. These advances suggest that future crop improvement strategies will increasingly rely on cell-type-specific engineering of transport processes and metabolic sinks rather than simply enhancing photosynthesis

摘要

源-库关系描述植物如何协调碳生产、运输和利用以支持生长、繁殖和胁迫响应。经典生理学研究建立了稳健的器官水平碳分配框架，但这些方法在很大程度上将组织视为均质单元。单细胞和空间组学技术的最新进展现已揭示，源和库均由具有特化代谢和运输功能的多样化细胞群体组成。在这篇综述中，我们综合了单细胞转录组学、空间转录组学和整合多组学的新兴见解，以展示细胞异质性如何塑造光合源强度、维管运输界面和库发育。我们进一步讨论了胁迫响应、信号分子和植物相关微生物组如何以空间结构化的方式动态重编程源-库关系。最后，我们强调了将高分辨率分子图谱与生理建模和机器学习方法相结合，以开发碳分配预测框架的机遇。这些进展表明，未来的作物改良策略将越来越依赖于对运输过程和代谢库的细胞类型特异性工程改造，而不仅仅是增强光合作用。

item.title: PhyloZoo: a unified framework for phylogenetic network analysis in Python | PhyloZoo：用于 Python 中系统发育网络分析的统一框架
item.description:
Abstract

Abstract Reticulate evolutionary processes (events in which lineages merge, such as hybridization, recombination, and horizontal gene transfer) are widespread across nature but cannot be represented by phylogenetic trees alone. Phylogenetic networks have therefore become an important modelling tool, yet existing software is typically tied to specific inference paradigms and provides limited support for working with multiple network representations in a unified and programmable environment. PhyloZoo is an open-source Python framework that lowers the barrier to developing practical, easy-to-use software for phylogenetic network analysis. It provides data structures and algorithms covering the main representations used in the field, together with dedicated visualization tools and robust I/O for all major phylogenetic file formats. A particular emphasis lies on semi-directed phylogenetic networks, which explicitly represent root uncertainty and have so far received limited support in existing software. By offering a shared, scalable foundation for developing interoperable tools and a combinatorial layer that supports computational proofs and theoretical exploration, PhyloZoo enables reproducible workflows for applied, methodological, and theoretical studies of reticulate evolution. Availability and implementation: PhyloZoo is implemented in Python and installable from PyPI, with source code, documentation, and examples available at https://github.com/nholtgrefe/phylozoo.

摘要

网状进化过程（谱系合并的事件，如杂交、重组和水平基因转移）在自然界中广泛存在，但不能仅由系统发育树表示。因此，系统发育网络已成为重要的建模工具，然而现有软件通常绑定于特定的推断范式，并且在统一且可编程的环境中处理多种网络表示方面支持有限。PhyloZoo 是一个开源 Python 框架，降低了开发实用、易用的系统发育网络分析软件的门槛。它提供了涵盖该领域主要表示形式的数据结构和算法，以及专用的可视化工具和对所有主要系统发育文件格式的稳健 I/O。特别强调半定向系统发育网络，这类网络明确表示根的不确定性，而现有软件迄今对其支持有限。通过提供一个共享、可扩展的基础以开发可互操作的工具，以及一个支持计算证明和理论探索的组合层，PhyloZoo 为网状进化的应用、方法和理论研究实现了可重复的工作流程。可用性与实现：PhyloZoo 用 Python 实现，可从 PyPI 安装，源代码、文档和示例见 https://github.com/nholtgrefe/phylozoo。

item.title: SETDB1 preferentially silences evolutionarily young retroelements | SETDB1 优先沉默进化上年轻的逆转录元件
item.description:
Abstract

Transposable elements (TEs) are epigenetically silenced through multiple mechanisms, including heterochromatin formation and DNA methylation. Prior studies have implicated SETDB1 and the Human Silencing Hub (HUSH) complex in heterochromatin formation-based TE repression, but precise characterization of repeat subclass and locus-specific effects for SETDB1 and related mechanisms has been limited by short-read transcriptome mapping. Here, we use long-read RNA sequencing mapped to a telomere-to-telomere mouse genome assembly to resolve the specific contributions of SETDB1 to TE silencing at single-locus resolution. Knockdown of SETDB1 or core HUSH factors reveals robust and reproducible derepression of a restricted subset of long terminal repeat (LTR) retroelements distinct from those of global DNA demethylation. This derepression is heterogeneous within TE subclasses and is confined to discrete genomic loci, highlighting regulatory diversity that is obscured by aggregate, family-level analyses. Time-resolved SETDB1 depletion followed by histone 3 lysine 9 (H3K9)me3, H3K9me2, and Pol II ChIP-seq reveals a stratified derepression response: ERVK and ERV1 elements show concordant H3K9 methylation loss, Pol II gain, and RNA expression induction, consistent with direct H3K9me3-mediated silencing, whereas LINE/L1 elements show transcriptional activation without corresponding H3K9me3 loss, implicating parallel repressive mechanisms. These data support a model in which SETDB1-dependent H3K9 methylation maintains silencing of evolutionarily young LTRs, while long interspersed nuclear element (LINE) repression engages broader heterochromatic pathways not fully captured by any single chromatin readout. Collectively, our findings refine current models of heterochromatin-mediated TE control and provide a framework for dissecting how chromatin-based mechanisms cooperate to maintain subclass-selective TE repression.

摘要

转座元件 （TEs） 通过多种机制被表观遗传沉默，包括异染色质形成和 DNA 甲基化。既往研究已表明 SETDB1 和 Human Silencing Hub （HUSH） 复合体参与基于异染色质形成的 TE 抑制，但由于短读长转录组映射的限制，对 SETDB1 及相关机制的重复序列亚类和位点特异性效应的精确刻画仍然有限。在这里，我们使用映射到端粒到端粒小鼠基因组组装的长读长 RNA 测序，以单基因座分辨率解析 SETDB1 对 TE 沉默的具体贡献。敲低 SETDB1 或核心 HUSH 因子可揭示一组受限的长末端重复 （LTR） 逆转录元件的强烈且可重复的去阻遏，这组元件不同于全局 DNA 去甲基化所影响的元件。这种去阻遏在 TE 亚类内部具有异质性，并局限于离散的基因组位点，突出了被聚合的、家族水平分析所掩盖的调控多样性。时间分辨的 SETDB1 耗竭随后进行组蛋白 3 赖氨酸 9 （H3K9）me3、H3K9me2 和 Pol II ChIP-seq，揭示了一种分层的去阻遏反应：ERVK 和 ERV1 元件显示一致的 H3K9 甲基化丢失、Pol II 增加和 RNA 表达诱导，与直接由 H3K9me3 介导的沉默一致；而 LINE/L1 元件显示转录激活，但没有相应的 H3K9me3 丢失，提示存在平行的抑制机制。这些数据支持一个模型：SETDB1 依赖的 H3K9 甲基化维持进化上年轻 LTR 的沉默，而长散布核元件 （LINE） 抑制涉及更广泛的异染色质通路，这些通路无法被任何单一染色质读出完全捕捉。总体而言，我们的发现完善了当前异染色质介导的 TE 控制模型，并提供了一个框架，用于剖析基于染色质的机制如何协同维持亚类选择性 TE 抑制。

item.title: Integrative characterization of the heat shock transcription factors in Acorus: evolution and heat-responsive regulatory patterns | 菖蒲属热激转录因子的整合表征：演化与热响应调控模式
item.description:
Abstract

With global climate change driving rising temperatures, the persistence and physiological performance of Acorus are increasingly threatened, highlighting the importance of understanding its molecular responses to heat stress. Heat shock transcription factors (HSFs) constitute a major family of transcriptional regulators involved in plant heat-stress responses and thermotolerance. Here, we identified 39 and 20 HSF genes in Acorus calamus and A. gramineus . Conserved motif and domain analyses revealed subfamily-specific structural features, while comparative synteny suggested that polyploidy and differential gene retention contributed to HSF family expansion in A. calamus . Subgenome-level analysis revealed no obvious difference in HSF gene number between subgenomes, whereas retained homeolog pairs exhibited tissue-dependent expression divergence. Promoter, predicted protein–protein interaction, and GO enrichment analyses linked AgHSFs to stress regulation and heat-response networks. Integrated analysis of time-series expression profiles, differential expression, weighted gene co-expression networks, and qRT-PCR revealed diverse temporal responses among AgHSFs and supported AgHSF07, AgHSF12, and AgHSF20 as strongly heat-responsive candidates for further characterization. AgHSF07 and AgHSF12 showed mainly nuclear YFP signals and strong autoactivation in the yeast system, supporting their potential roles as transcriptional activators. Together, this integrated genomic–transcriptomic framework provides insights into HSF evolution and heat-response regulation in Acorus and highlights AgHSF07 and AgHSF12 as promising candidate regulators for further functional studies of thermotolerance.

摘要

随着全球气候变化推动气温上升，菖蒲属（Acorus）的存续和生理表现日益受到威胁，凸显了理解其热胁迫分子响应的重要性。热激转录因子（HSFs）是参与植物热胁迫响应和耐热性的主要转录调控因子家族。在此，我们在水菖蒲（Acorus calamus）和石菖蒲（A. gramineus）中分别鉴定出 39 个和 20 个 HSF 基因。保守基序和结构域分析揭示了亚家族特异性的结构特征，而比较共线性分析表明，多倍化和差异基因保留促进了 A. calamus 中 HSF 家族的扩张。亚基因组水平分析显示，亚基因组之间 HSF 基因数量无明显差异，但保留的 homeolog 对表现出组织依赖性的表达分化。启动子、预测的蛋白质–蛋白质相互作用和 GO 富集分析将 AgHSFs 与胁迫调控和热响应网络联系起来。对时间序列表达谱、差异表达、加权基因共表达网络和 qRT-PCR 的整合分析揭示了 AgHSFs 之间多样的时序响应，并支持 AgHSF07、AgHSF12 和 AgHSF20 作为强热响应候选基因用于进一步表征。AgHSF07 和 AgHSF12 主要显示核内 YFP 信号，并在酵母系统中表现出强自激活，支持它们作为转录激活因子的潜在作用。总之，这一整合的基因组–转录组框架为理解菖蒲属（Acorus）中 HSF 演化和热响应调控提供了见解，并突出 AgHSF07 和 AgHSF12 作为有前景的候选调控因子，可用于进一步的耐热性功能研究。

item.title: Unveiling the adaptive strategies in Blumea Balsamifera roots under salt stress through integrated physiological and multi-omics analysis | 通过整合生理学和多组学分析揭示盐胁迫下 Blumea balsamifera 根的适应策略
item.description:
Abstract

Background Soil salinization is a growing constraint on agricultural productivity, yet the adaptive mechanisms of many medicinal plants—particularly Blumea balsamifera , a species of significant economic and pharmacological value—remain poorly understood. In this study, five treatments—CK (control), LS (low salt), MS (medium salt), HS (high salt), and EHS (extremely high salt)—were established to systematically investigate the comprehensive effects of salt stress on the growth, physiological metabolism, and molecular regulatory networks of B. balsamifera. Results The results showed that salt stress significantly inhibited the growth of B. balsamifera , causing leaf chlorosis and wilting. In roots, the activities of antioxidant enzymes (SOD, POD, CAT) and the level of malondialdehyde (MDA) initially increased and then decreased, while the accumulation of osmoregulatory substances (PRO, SS, SP) and lignin (LIG) progressively increased. Transcriptomic analysis identified 5,701 differentially expressed genes (DEGs) shared between the HS vs CK and EHS vs CK comparisons, which were significantly enriched in functional terms including transcription factor activity, cell wall organization, plant hormone signal transduction. Metabolomic analysis identified 590 and 647 differentially accumulated metabolites (DAMs) in the HS vs CK and EHS vs CK comparisons, respectively. Under moderate stress, flavonoid synthesis and cutin/suberin biosynthesis pathways were significantly enriched, whereas under extreme stress, the phenylpropanoid pathway, carbohydrate metabolism pathway, and oxylipin/jasmonate-related metabolism pathways were significantly activated. Integrated multi-omics analysis further revealed that cutin, suberin, and wax biosynthesis, phenylpropanoid biosynthesis, and oxylipin/jasmonate-related metabolism are the core synergistic pathways in the root response of B. balsamifera to salt stress, mediating physical barrier construction, chemical defense and structural reinforcement, and lipid signal transduction, respectively. Conclusion Collectively, these findings uncover a multilayered adaptive strategy in B. balsamifera roots under salt stress, namely physical barrier formation, chemical-structural defense, and membrane lipid signaling. These results provide theoretical insights and key molecular targets for breeding salt-tolerant varieties and developing stress-resilient cultivation strategies.

摘要

背景：土壤盐渍化日益制约农业生产，但许多药用植物——尤其是具有重要经济和药理价值的 Blumea balsamifera——的适应机制仍知之甚少。本研究设置了五种处理——CK（对照）、LS（低盐）、MS（中盐）、HS（高盐）和 EHS（极高盐）——以系统研究盐胁迫对 B. balsamifera 生长、生理代谢和分子调控网络的综合影响。结果：结果表明，盐胁迫显著抑制了 B. balsamifera 的生长，导致叶片黄化和萎蔫。在根中，抗氧化酶（SOD、POD、CAT）活性和丙二醛（MDA）水平先升高后降低，而渗透调节物质（PRO、SS、SP）和木质素（LIG）的积累逐渐增加。转录组分析鉴定出 5,701 个在 HS vs CK 和 EHS vs CK 比较中共有的差异表达基因（DEGs），这些基因显著富集于转录因子活性、细胞壁组织、植物激素信号转导等功能条目中。代谢组分析分别在 HS vs CK 和 EHS vs CK 比较中鉴定出 590 和 647 个差异积累代谢物（DAMs）。在中等胁迫下，类黄酮合成和角质素/木栓质生物合成途径显著富集，而在极端胁迫下，苯丙烷类途径、碳水化合物代谢途径以及 oxylipin/茉莉酸相关代谢途径被显著激活。整合多组学分析进一步揭示，角质素、木栓质和蜡质生物合成，苯丙烷类生物合成，以及 oxylipin/茉莉酸相关代谢是 B. balsamifera 根响应盐胁迫的核心协同途径，分别介导物理屏障构建、化学防御与结构强化以及脂质信号转导。结论：总体而言，这些发现揭示了盐胁迫下 B. balsamifera 根的多层次适应策略，即物理屏障形成、化学-结构防御和膜脂信号传导。这些结果为培育耐盐品种和制定抗逆栽培策略提供了理论见解和关键分子靶点。

item.title: Comparative mitogenomics of Roscoea alpina and R. purpurea from contrasting elevations reveals mitochondrial genomic differentiation | 对比不同海拔的 Roscoea alpina 与 R. purpurea 的比较线粒体基因组学揭示线粒体基因组分化
item.description:
Abstract

Plant mitochondrial genomes are structurally dynamic and contribute to energy metabolism and stress responses. Comparative mitogenomic analyses of closely related species occupying contrasting elevations can provide insights into mitochondrial genomic differentiation across elevational environments. Using PacBio HiFi reads, we assembled and compared the mitochondrial genomes of the higher-altitude species R. alpina and the lower-altitude species R. purpurea . Both mitochondrial genome assemblies yielded graph-like structures, with R. alpina exhibiting a more complex assembly-graph topology, more dispersed repeats, and extensive evidence of dispersed-repeat-mediated recombination. Despite these structural differences, the two species retained broadly similar core gene complements, codon-usage patterns, and predicted RNA-editing profiles. Among genes represented by multiple annotated copies in both species, 12 had higher annotated copy numbers in R. alpina . Most shared protein-coding genes were highly conserved, whereas nad4 and rps3 each contained two nonsynonymous substitutions between the two species. Genes with higher annotated copy numbers and those showing limited sequence divergence were both annotated into respiratory complex I and mitochondrial translation. These results reveal pronounced differentiation in mitochondrial genome architecture alongside strong conservation of coding characteristics. Both the differences in gene representation and the limited sequence divergence converge on the same functional processes, suggesting a potential link between mitochondrial genomic changes and adaptation to high-altitude environments. We hypothesize that these genomic features may be relevant to the physiological performance of R. alpina in a high-altitude environment.

摘要

植物线粒体基因组在结构上具有动态性，并参与能量代谢和胁迫响应。对占据对比海拔的密切近缘物种进行比较线粒体基因组分析，可为理解跨海拔环境的线粒体基因组分化提供线索。利用 PacBio HiFi reads，我们组装并比较了较高海拔物种 R. alpina 与较低海拔物种 R. purpurea 的线粒体基因组。两个线粒体基因组组装均产生类图结构，其中 R. alpina 表现出更复杂的组装图拓扑结构、更分散的重复序列，以及广泛的分散重复介导重组的证据。尽管存在这些结构差异，两个物种仍保留了大致相似的核心基因组成、密码子使用模式和预测的 RNA 编辑谱。在两个物种中均有多个注释拷贝的基因中，有 12 个基因在 R. alpina 中具有更高的注释拷贝数。大多数共有的蛋白质编码基因高度保守，而 nad4 和 rps3 各自在两个物种之间含有两个非同义替换。具有更高注释拷贝数的基因以及显示有限序列分化的基因均被注释到呼吸复合体 I 和线粒体翻译中。这些结果揭示了线粒体基因组结构的显著分化，同时编码特征具有强保守性。基因代表性的差异和有限的序列分化都汇聚到相同的功能过程，提示线粒体基因组变化与高海拔环境适应之间可能存在联系。我们假设这些基因组特征可能与 R. alpina 在高海拔环境中的生理表现相关。

item.title: Golden biomass: unlocking the potential of neglected potato (Solanum tuberosum L.) side-streams as sources of bioactive compounds | 金色生物质：释放被忽视的马铃薯（Solanum tuberosum L.）副产物作为生物活性化合物来源的潜力
item.description:
Abstract

Background Potato flowers and berries are largely unused agricultural side-streams that may provide bioactive compounds for pharmaceutical and plant protection applications in a circular bioeconomy. This study evaluated their potential as sources of secondary metabolites and assessed whether premature harvesting affects final tuber yield. Methods Field trials with two potato cultivars were combined with targeted HPLC-MS/MS analysis, untargeted metabolomics, and RNA-Seq analysis of flowers and developing berries. Results Berries produced substantially more biomass than flowers, whereas flowers generally contained higher concentrations of total glycoalkaloids (calculated as the sum of a-solanine and a-chaconine). This reached 393.95 mg/100 g FW in ‘Quarta’ flowers compared to 70.92 mg/100 g FW in berries, with the concentration of a-chaconine up to 3.33-fold higher than that of a-solanine. Untargeted metabolomics identified glycoalkaloids, phenolic compounds, and other secondary metabolites, with peak intensities of rutin and some others declining from ~1Å~10 9 to ~1Å~10 5 during berry development. Transcriptomic analysis showed that tissue and developmental stage had a substantially greater influence on gene expression patterns than cultivar. Genes associated with phenylpropanoid, terpenoid and steroid-related pathways were differentially expressed, with overall stronger upregulation in flowers than in small and big berries. Premature flower harvest did not reduce tuber yield, whereas berry harvest reduced yield for one cultivar in one field experiment. Conclusion Overall, flowers and berries harvested as side streams in the potato production can be a good source for glycoalkaloids and possibly further metabolites of use for pharmaceutical and plant protection applications. Flowers appear particularly suitable for recovering high-concentration bioactive compounds, whereas berries offer advantages in biomass availability, harvesting, and storage.

摘要

背景 马铃薯花和浆果基本上是未被利用的农业副产物，在循环生物经济中可能为制药和植物保护应用提供生物活性化合物。本研究评估了它们作为次生代谢物来源的潜力，并评估了提前采收是否影响最终块茎产量。方法 将两个马铃薯品种的田间试验与靶向 HPLC-MS/MS 分析、非靶向代谢组学以及对花和发育中浆果的 RNA-Seq 分析相结合。结果 浆果产生的生物量显著多于花，而花通常含有更高浓度的总糖苷生物碱（按α-茄碱和α-卡茄碱之和计算）。在‘Quarta’花中达到 393.95 mg/100 g 鲜重，而浆果中为 70.92 mg/100 g 鲜重，其中α-卡茄碱浓度比α-茄碱高可达 3.33 倍。非靶向代谢组学鉴定出糖苷生物碱、酚类化合物和其他次生代谢物，其中芦丁和某些其他代谢物的峰强度在浆果发育过程中从~1×10^9 下降至~1×10^5。转录组分析表明，组织和发育阶段对基因表达模式的影响远大于品种。与苯丙素类、萜类和甾体相关通路相关的基因差异表达，总体上在花中的上调强于小浆果和大浆果。提前采收花并未降低块茎产量，而在一次田间试验中，采收浆果降低了一个品种的产量。结论 总体而言，在马铃薯生产中作为副产物收获的花和浆果可以是糖苷生物碱的良好来源，并可能是可用于制药和植物保护应用的更多代谢物的来源。花似乎特别适合回收高浓度生物活性化合物，而浆果在生物量可获取性、采收和储存方面具有优势。

item.title: Optimization of protoplast cell division and microcallus formation toward somatic embryogenesis in oil palm | 油棕中面向体细胞胚胎发生的原生质体细胞分裂与微愈伤组织形成优化
item.description:
Abstract

Background Efficient protoplast regeneration remains a major obstacle to the application of somatic hybridization, genome editing and precision breeding in oil palm ( Elaeis guineensis ); while early developmental stages, from cell wall regeneration and cell division to microcolony and microcallus formation, could be more important, which could be connected easily with the traditional tissue culture system for succeeding plant regeneration. This study aimed to optimize the protopalst culture conditions for cell division and microcallus formation by identifying the most effective combinations of culture systems, basal media and plant growth regulators. Methods Protoplasts isolated from different oil palm tissues (embryogenic callus, suspension cultures, and somatic embryos) were investigated by protoplast yield and viability; protoplasts from the embryogenic callus showed the most satisfactory response and was therefore used for subsequent optimization of culture conditions. The protoplasts were cultured using six culture systems (liquid, droplet, agarose pool, well-plate culture, feeder layer, and nurse culture) in combination with eight basal media (BH3, MS, WPM, Y3, KM, B5, N6, and KPR), and the culture effects were evaluated based on protoplast viability, plating efficiency, cell division, microcolony and microcallus formation. Microcallus emerged from the KPR solid medium were transferred to previously established traditional tissue culture system for further somatic embryogenesis and regeneration. Results BH3 liquid medium was particularly effective for early protoplast recovery and rapid cell wall regeneration, whereas KPR solid medium combined with the nurse culture system, provided the most favorable conditions for sustained cell division, plating efficiency, microcolony and microcallus formation. Cell division occurred within 3–7 days, followed by microcolony formation after approximately 7 days and visible microcallus formation after 60 days. Microcallus were transferred for further development, somatic embryos and bud regeneration was observed after 90 days and 120 days, respectively. Conclusions The present study focused on the early developmental stages of oil palm protoplast culture, and optimized a stage-specific culture strategy for quick microcallus formation; combined with previous oil palm tissue culture system, further somatic embryogenesis and bud regeneration were established successfully. This work not only promoted the protoplast regeneration of oil palm, but also provides a promising strategy for other tropical palm trees such as coconut and betel nut.

摘要

背景 高效的原生质体再生仍然是油棕（Elaeis guineensis）体细胞杂交、基因组编辑和精准育种应用的主要障碍；而早期发育阶段，从细胞壁再生和细胞分裂到微细胞团和微愈伤组织形成，可能更为重要，并且可以容易地与用于后续植株再生的传统组织培养体系相衔接。本研究旨在通过确定培养系统、基础培养基和植物生长调节剂的最有效组合，优化原生质体培养条件以促进细胞分裂和微愈伤组织形成。方法 对从不同油棕组织（胚性愈伤组织、悬浮培养物和体细胞胚）分离的原生质体进行了原生质体产量和活力考察；来自胚性愈伤组织的原生质体表现出最令人满意的反应，因此被用于后续培养条件的优化。将原生质体采用六种培养系统（液体培养、液滴培养、琼脂糖池培养、孔板培养、饲养层培养和看护培养）与八种基础培养基（BH3、MS、WPM、Y3、KM、B5、N6 和 KPR）组合进行培养，并基于原生质体活力、植板率、细胞分裂、微细胞团和微愈伤组织形成来评价培养效果。从 KPR 固体培养基上产生的微愈伤组织被转移至先前建立的传统组织培养体系，以进行进一步的体细胞胚胎发生和再生。结果 BH3 液体培养基对早期原生质体恢复和快速细胞壁再生特别有效，而 KPR 固体培养基与看护培养系统组合，为持续的细胞分裂、植板率、微细胞团和微愈伤组织形成提供了最有利的条件。细胞分裂在 3–7 天内发生，随后在约 7 天后形成微细胞团，并在 60 天后形成可见的微愈伤组织。微愈伤组织被转移以进一步发育，分别在 90 天和 120 天后观察到体细胞胚和芽再生。结论 本研究聚焦于油棕原生质体培养的早期发育阶段，并优化了一种用于快速形成微愈伤组织的阶段特异性培养策略；结合此前的油棕组织培养体系，成功建立了进一步的体细胞胚胎发生和芽再生。这项工作不仅促进了油棕的原生质体再生，还为其他热带棕榈树（如椰子和槟榔）提供了有前景的策略。

item.title: Genome editing beyond transgenes: DNA-free technologies in crop improvement | 超越转基因的基因组编辑：作物改良中的无 DNA 技术
item.description:
Abstract

Conventional and transgenic approaches to crop improvement are increasingly constrained by biosafety concerns, stringent regulatory frameworks, and limited public acceptance, necessitating new precision breeding methods. DNA-free genome editing using the CRISPR/Cas9 approach has emerged as a transformative approach that enables precise, targeted genetic modifications without the stable integration of a foreign gene (transgene). This strategy transiently introduces CRISPR/Cas9 ribonucleoprotein (RNP) complexes, or in vitro transcribed mRNA, into plant cells. This review focuses primarily on CRISPR/Cas-mediated DNA-free genome editing and its applications in crop improvement. After targeted genome cleavage, the editing elements are rapidly degraded, leaving only the desired genomic modification and resulting in plants indistinguishable from those developed through conventional breeding. To achieve targeted, DNA-free genome editing, researchers have developed numerous molecular platforms and delivery systems, such as protoplast transfection, biolistic bombardment, nanoparticle-based systems, and emerging pollen- and meristem-targeted systems, for major crop species. Researchers have successfully enhanced several notable traits, including disease and pest resistance, nutritional quality, abiotic stress tolerance, and agronomic performance, in cereals, vegetables, oilseeds, and perennial crops. Recent advancements, including base editing, prime editing, and multiplex gene editing, are further expanding the precision, efficiency, and scope of DNA-free genome editing. Overall, CRISPR/Cas-mediated DNA-free genome editing offers a route to crop improvement that avoids stable transgene integration, though its wider deployment depends on progress in regeneration, molecular validation, and regulatory convergence.

摘要

传统和转基因作物改良方法日益受到生物安全担忧、严格监管框架和有限公众接受度的制约，因而需要新的精准育种方法。利用 CRISPR/Cas9 方法的无 DNA 基因组编辑已成为一种变革性方法，能够在不稳定整合外源基因（转基因）的情况下实现精准、靶向的遗传修饰。该策略将 CRISPR/Cas9 核糖核蛋白（RNP）复合物或体外转录的 mRNA 瞬时导入植物细胞。本综述主要关注 CRISPR/Cas 介导的无 DNA 基因组编辑及其在作物改良中的应用。在靶向基因组切割后，编辑元件迅速降解，仅留下所需的基因组修饰，所得植物与传统育种培育的植物无法区分。为实现靶向、无 DNA 的基因组编辑，研究人员已为主要作物物种开发了众多分子平台和递送系统，例如原生质体转染、基因枪轰击、基于纳米颗粒的系统，以及新兴的靶向花粉和分生组织的系统。研究人员已成功在谷物、蔬菜、油料作物和多年生作物中增强了若干显著性状，包括抗病抗虫性、营养品质、非生物胁迫耐受性和农艺表现。近期进展，包括碱基编辑、先导编辑和多重基因编辑，正在进一步扩展无 DNA 基因组编辑的精准性、效率和范围。总体而言，CRISPR/Cas 介导的无 DNA 基因组编辑提供了一条避免稳定转基因整合的作物改良途径，尽管其更广泛应用取决于再生、分子验证和监管趋同方面的进展。

item.title: The m6A regulatory network in plant stress adaptation: from mechanisms to breeding potential | 植物胁迫适应中的 m6A 调控网络：从机制到育种潜力
item.description:
Abstract

N 6 -methyladenosine (m 6 A) is the most abundant internal modification of eukaryotic mRNA and is dynamically regulated by three classes of proteins: writers, erasers, and readers. Writers deposit methylation marks, erasers confer reversibility, and readers translate these signals into specific regulatory outcomes, collectively modulating mRNA stability, translation efficiency, splicing, and polyadenylation, thereby influencing plant stress adaptation. Studies across diverse plant species have revealed both conserved principles and species-specific variations in this regulatory network. Technological advances, such as methylated RNA immunoprecipitation sequencing (MeRIP-seq) and nanopore direct RNA sequencing, have enabled transcriptome-wide m 6 A profiling. However, functional validation of m 6 A modification in most crops remains limited to a few model species and controlled environments, and their practical breeding potential requires systematic evaluation. This review systematically summarizes the functions of m 6 A writers, erasers, and readers in crop stress responses, synthesizes the regulatory patterns at the levels of mRNA stability, translation efficiency, and splicing and discusses m 6 A-based breeding strategies and their current bottlenecks, providing a theoretical reference for stress-resilient crop breeding. CRISPR/dCas13-based targeted modification systems, together with methyltransferase overexpression or demethylase knockout strategies, have demonstrated breeding potential in several crops, although field-level validation remains limited. Future research needs to prioritize how the writer-eraser-reader network achieves stress-specific regulation without causing pleiotropic developmental defects, how m 6 A pattern differs between single and combined stresses, and how natural variation in m 6 A regulatory gene can be exploited for breeding. On this basis, establishing causal links between specific m 6 A sites and agronomic phenotypes, while integrating multi-omics approaches and precision editing technologies, will be essential to translate epitranscriptomic knowledge into crop improvement.

摘要

N6-甲基腺苷（m6A）是真核 mRNA 中最丰富的内部修饰，并由三类蛋白动态调控：写入器、擦除器和阅读器。写入器沉积甲基化标记，擦除器赋予可逆性，阅读器将这些信号转化为特定调控结果，共同调节 mRNA 稳定性、翻译效率、剪接和多聚腺苷酸化，从而影响植物胁迫适应。对不同植物物种的研究揭示了该调控网络中的保守原则和物种特异性变异。甲基化 RNA 免疫沉淀测序（MeRIP-seq）和纳米孔直接 RNA 测序等技术进展，使全转录组 m6A 图谱分析成为可能。然而，大多数作物中 m6A 修饰的功能验证仍局限于少数模式物种和受控环境，其实际育种潜力需要系统评估。本综述系统总结了 m6A 写入器、擦除器和阅读器在作物胁迫响应中的功能，综合了 mRNA 稳定性、翻译效率和剪接层面的调控模式，并讨论了基于 m6A 的育种策略及其当前瓶颈，为抗逆作物育种提供理论参考。基于 CRISPR/dCas13 的靶向修饰系统，连同甲基转移酶过表达或去甲基化酶敲除策略，已在几种作物中显示出育种潜力，尽管田间水平验证仍然有限。未来研究需要优先关注写入器-擦除器-阅读器网络如何实现胁迫特异性调控而不引起多效性发育缺陷，m6A 模式在单一胁迫与复合胁迫之间有何差异，以及如何利用 m6A 调控基因的自然变异进行育种。在此基础上，建立特定 m6A 位点与农艺性状之间的因果联系，同时整合多组学方法和精准编辑技术，对于将表观转录组学知识转化为作物改良至关重要。

item.title: Alkaline salt impairs germination recovery more severely than neutral salt in the euhalophyte Suaeda salsa | 碱性盐比中性盐更严重地损害真盐生植物盐地碱蓬的萌发恢复
item.description:
Abstract

Introduction Soil salinization and alkalization increasingly threaten global ecosystem stability, necessitating a clearer understanding of how dominant halophytes respond to complex salt stresses. Methods This study examined the differential effects of neutral and alkaline salt stresses on seed germination and early seedling growth of Suaeda salsa , a dominant halophyte in the Yellow River Delta. A two-factor factorial experiment was conducted using three salt types (NaCl, KCl, NaHCO 3 ) across six concentration gradients (0–500 mmol L -1 ). A two-stage germination trial, comprising an initial stress phase and a post-stress recovery phase, assessed root and shoot growth, fresh mass accumulation, water potential, and germination ratios. Results Salt concentration primarily determined germination traits. At comparable molar concentrations, alkaline salt (NaHCO 3 ) exerted significantly stronger inhibition on growth than the neutral salts (NaCl, KCl). Low-concentration NaCl promoted fresh mass accumulation and sustained shoot elongation through efficient osmotic adjustment, whereas alkaline stress severely impaired this capacity, inducing acute physiological drought. The secondary germination trial revealed an “enforced dormancy” strategy: the effects of neutral salt stress were largely reversible, with markedly enhanced germination upon stress relief, whereas alkaline salt stress reduced recovery potential, fundamentally compromising recovery potential. Discussion Neutral and alkaline components must be distinguished when evaluating soil degradation. Future ecological restoration in the Yellow River Delta should prioritize amelioration of high-pH alkaline conditions to ensure natural regeneration of halophyte communities.

摘要

引言 土壤盐化和碱化日益威胁全球生态系统稳定性，因此需要更清晰地理解优势盐生植物如何响应复杂的盐胁迫。方法 本研究考察了中性盐和碱性盐胁迫对黄河三角洲优势盐生植物盐地碱蓬（Suaeda salsa）种子萌发和早期幼苗生长的差异影响。采用双因素析因实验，设置三种盐类型（NaCl、KCl、NaHCO3）和六个浓度梯度（0–500 mmol L-1）。两阶段萌发试验包括初始胁迫阶段和胁迫后恢复阶段，评估了根和地上部生长、鲜质量积累、水势和萌发率。结果 盐浓度主要决定萌发性状。在相近摩尔浓度下，碱性盐（NaHCO3）对生长的抑制显著强于中性盐（NaCl、KCl）。低浓度 NaCl 通过有效的渗透调节促进鲜质量积累并维持地上部伸长，而碱性胁迫严重损害了这一能力，诱导急性生理干旱。第二次萌发试验揭示了一种“强制休眠”策略：中性盐胁迫的影响在很大程度上是可逆的，胁迫解除后萌发显著增强；而碱性盐胁迫降低了恢复潜力，从根本上损害了恢复潜力。讨论 在评估土壤退化时，必须区分中性和碱性组分。未来黄河三角洲的生态恢复应优先改善高 pH 碱性条件，以确保盐生植物群落的自然更新。

item.title: Culture medium and plant growth regulator regimes influence the transcriptome and cannabisin accumulation in Cannabis sativa cell suspension cultures | 培养基和植物生长调节剂方案影响 Cannabis sativa 细胞悬浮培养中的转录组和 cannabisin 积累
item.description:
Abstract

Plant cell suspension cultures are a valuable biotechnological platform for the controlled production of high-value phytochemicals. Yet, the molecular mechanisms by which culture medium composition impacts cellular transcriptional programs remain poorly characterised, especially in non-model plant species. Here, we investigated how two culture media, Murashige & Skoog (MS)- and Linsmaier & Skoog (LS)-based, influence growth, gene expression and secondary metabolite production in Cannabis sativa cell suspension cultures derived from a non-commercial genotype, Line 43/178. Cultures were analysed at five time points across a 14-day subculture cycle. Both media supported comparable growth kinetics, with a peak in biomass production reaching values ≥13 g/L dry weight. Transcriptomic analysis identified 2801 differentially expressed contigs with an absolute maximum fold change >10 and revealed distinct growth-stage responses, including early activation of cell cycle and hormone-related genes, intermediate induction of stress and cell wall remodelling pathways and late-stage senescence and redox-related processes. LS induced the expression of genes involved in hydroxycinnamic acid amide and lignanamide production, in agreement with untargeted metabolomic data showing increased accumulation of cannabisin D and cannabisin F, together with marked differences in cell morphology. Spectrophotometric analyses further revealed medium-dependent differences in total phenolic content and antioxidant activity. By adopting a transcriptomic approach coupled to the identification of lignanamides via untargeted metabolomics, the study highlights how medium composition regulates the balance between growth and secondary metabolism in C. sativa cell cultures, providing valuable insights for future optimisation of bioactive compound production using plant cell factories.

摘要

植物细胞悬浮培养是用于可控生产高价值植物化学物的宝贵生物技术平台。然而，培养基组成影响细胞转录程序的分子机制仍表征不足，尤其是在非模式植物物种中。在此，我们研究了两种培养基——基于 Murashige & Skoog（MS）和 Linsmaier & Skoog（LS）——如何影响源自非商业基因型 Line 43/178 的 Cannabis sativa 细胞悬浮培养物的生长、基因表达和次级代谢物产生。在 14 天继代培养周期内的五个时间点对培养物进行分析。两种培养基支持可比的生长动力学，生物量生产峰值达到 ≥13 g/L 干重。转录组分析鉴定出 2801 个差异表达 contig，绝对最大倍数变化 >10，并揭示了不同的生长阶段响应，包括细胞周期和激素相关基因的早期激活、胁迫和细胞壁重塑途径的中期诱导以及晚期衰老和氧化还原相关过程。LS 诱导了参与羟基肉桂酸酰胺和木脂素酰胺（lignanamide）产生的基因表达，这与非靶向代谢组学数据显示的 cannabisin D 和 cannabisin F 积累增加以及细胞形态的显著差异一致。分光光度分析进一步揭示了总酚含量和抗氧化活性的培养基依赖性差异。通过采用转录组学方法并结合通过非靶向代谢组学鉴定木脂素酰胺，该研究强调了培养基组成如何调控 C. sativa 细胞培养中生长与次级代谢之间的平衡，为未来利用植物细胞工厂优化生物活性化合物生产提供了有价值的见解。

item.title: Differences in microbial composition and salt tolerance between rhizosphere and bulk soil of Kalidium foliatum | 盐爪爪（Kalidium foliatum）根际与非根际土壤微生物组成和耐盐性差异
item.description:
Abstract

Salt is an important abiotic stress that affects plant growth. Research has shown that plants can recruit beneficial microorganisms from the surrounding soil. However, the ecological functions of the rhizosphere microbiome in salt tolerant plants have not been explored to a large extent. Based on this, this study took the halophyte K. foliatum as the research object, and used metagenomics technology to analyze the differences in microbial composition and salt tolerance functional genes between the rhizosphere and bulk soil of K. foliatum in different salt habitats, providing new theoretical basis for salt alkali management. The results showed that the dominant groups in the rhizosphere soil microbial community of K. foliatum under two salt habitats were Actinobacteria, Proteobacteria, Bacteroidetes, and Chloroflexi. The abundance of 49 genera in Actinobacteria in high salt rhizosphere were significantly higher than that in low salt rhizosphere. These microorganisms belong to soil salt tolerant and halophilic microorganisms, and have the ability to improve plant salt tolerance. In high salt habitat, the expression of genes related to ion transport ( nqrA , nhaC , rnfC , chaA , and yrbG ) and the synthesis of osmoregulatory substances ( proP , ectA ) was significantly increased. These genes are associated with Na + , K + , Mg 2+ , proline and ectoine involved in transport or synthesis. The correlation indicates that halophilic archaea have a greater impact on functional genes than other microorganisms, suggesting that halophilic bacteria have a more prominent ability to regulate salt tolerance of K. foliatum .

摘要

盐是影响植物生长的重要非生物胁迫。研究表明，植物可以从周围土壤中招募有益微生物。然而，耐盐植物根际微生物组的生态功能尚未得到充分探索。基于此，本研究以盐生植物盐爪爪（K. foliatum）为研究对象，采用宏基因组学技术分析不同盐生境下盐爪爪根际与非根际土壤微生物组成及耐盐功能基因的差异，为盐碱治理提供新的理论依据。结果表明，两种盐生境下盐爪爪根际土壤微生物群落的优势类群为放线菌门（Actinobacteria）、变形菌门（Proteobacteria）、拟杆菌门（Bacteroidetes）和绿弯菌门（Chloroflexi）。高盐根际中放线菌门 49 个属的丰度显著高于低盐根际。这些微生物属于土壤耐盐和嗜盐微生物，具有提高植物耐盐性的能力。在高盐生境中，离子转运相关基因（nqrA、nhaC、rnfC、chaA 和 yrbG）以及渗透调节物质合成相关基因（proP、ectA）的表达显著增加。这些基因与 Na+、K+、Mg2+、脯氨酸和四氢嘧啶的转运或合成有关。相关性表明，嗜盐古菌对功能基因的影响大于其他微生物，提示嗜盐细菌具有更突出的调控盐爪爪耐盐性的能力。

item.title: STRONG3 promotes lignin biosynthesis and culm strength in rice | STRONG3 促进水稻木质素生物合成与茎秆强度
item.description:
Abstract

Summary Lodging severely reduces rice yield and quality. Culm strength, mainly determined by lignin biosynthesis and secondary cell wall (SCW) formation, is core to lodging resistance. We identified an ethylene response factor (ERF) transcription factor STRONG3 via genome‐wide association study (GWAS) of 405 rice accessions based on lignin content. Functional validation demonstrated that STRONG3 positively regulates lignin accumulation, culm diameter, and mechanical strength by promoting sclerenchyma tissue development, vascular bundle enlargement, and SCW thickening. Molecular analyses revealed that STRONG3 directly binds to the GCC‐box motif in the promoter of 4CL4 , a rate‐limiting enzyme in the phenylpropanoid pathway, to activate its transcription. Genetic complementation confirmed that 4CL4 acts downstream of STRONG3 to mediate lignin biosynthesis and culm development. Haplotype analysis identified subspecies‐specific favorable alleles: STRONG3 G in Geng rice, caused by a single nucleotide polymorphism (4349512) leading to an Ala289Thr substitution in the activation domain that enhances STRONG3's transcriptional activation of 4CL4 , and 4CL4 TC in Xian rice. Combinatorial analysis showed these alleles synergistically improve culm traits in their respective subspecies. Overexpression of STRONG3 enhanced lodging resistance without compromising grain yield. Our findings uncover a critical regulatory pathway for rice culm development and provide valuable genetic resources and molecular markers for breeding high‐yield, lodging‐resistant rice varieties.

摘要

倒伏严重降低水稻产量和品质。茎秆强度主要由木质素生物合成和次生细胞壁（secondary cell wall, SCW）形成决定，是抗倒伏的核心。我们基于木质素含量，对 405 份水稻种质进行全基因组关联研究（genome-wide association study, GWAS），鉴定出一个乙烯响应因子（ethylene response factor, ERF）转录因子 STRONG3。功能验证表明，STRONG3 通过促进厚壁组织发育、维管束增大和 SCW 增厚，正向调控木质素积累、茎秆直径和机械强度。分子分析揭示，STRONG3 直接结合苯丙烷代谢途径中的限速酶 4CL4 启动子中的 GCC-box 基序，以激活其转录。遗传互补证实，4CL4 作用于 STRONG3 下游，介导木质素生物合成和茎秆发育。单倍型分析鉴定出亚种特异性有利等位基因：粳稻（Geng rice）中的 STRONG3 G，由单核苷酸多态性（4349512）引起，导致激活域中 Ala289Thr 替换，从而增强 STRONG3 对 4CL4 的转录激活；以及籼稻（Xian rice）中的 4CL4 TC。组合分析显示，这些等位基因在各自亚种中协同改善茎秆性状。过表达 STRONG3 增强了抗倒伏性，且不损害籽粒产量。我们的发现揭示了水稻茎秆发育的关键调控途径，并为培育高产、抗倒伏水稻品种提供了宝贵的遗传资源和分子标记。

item.description:
Abstract

Abstract Poplar adapts to different nitrogen environments by regulating root N uptake and assimilation processes, but the integrated regulatory mechanisms underlying these responses remain unclear. Abstract The conquest of land by plants stands as a landmark event in the evolutionary history of Earth. Abstract

Abstract The root meristem is essential for stem cell maintenance and root development in plants. Abstract

Abstract Motivation The study of transposable elements (TEs) has become increasingly central to fields such as cancer biology, immunology, and aging. Accurately quantifying disease- or laboratory-mediated perturbations in these elements is critical to support this expanding research, yet current RNA-seq pipelines struggle with the pervasive overlap between TEs and protein-coding genes. Existing tools either aggregate to the subfamily level with no locus resolution (TEtranscripts), or provide locus-level quantification without modeling gene overlap (Telescope), with the latter attributing over 40% of TE signal to the 1.1% of loci that overlap gene exons. Splice junction evidence informs transcript-level priors, enabling MAJEC to probabilistically distinguish genic from TE-derived reads. This approach was independently validated against Salmon and RSEM on isoform quantification benchmarks. The joint feature space reduces exon-overlap contamination of locus-level TE estimates from 43% of total signal (Telescope) to 5% (MAJEC), while preserving subfamily-level accuracy (differential expression r = 0.987 vs TEtranscripts). Abstract

Abstract Background and Aims In southwestern Australia, plants have persisted through significant climate shifts in ancient landscapes, and the evolutionary responses are apparent in their genetic signature. Kalloora (Podocarpus drouynianus) belongs to a genus typically found in wet, montane environments. A median-joining maximum parsimony network was generated, estimates of population differentiation and neutrality and expansion tests were calculated, and the distribution of haplotypes was mapped to visualise their geographic arrangement. Abstract

Sexual reproduction facilitates the purging of deleterious mutations via recombination. Apomixis, defined by asexual seed formation, involves suppressed meiosis, thereby reducing the efficacy of purifying selection. However, the evolutionary consequences of apomixis remain poorly understood. In this study, we used wild citrus ( Citrus hindsii ), which has both sexual and apomictic (adventitious embryony) lineages, as a diploid genetic system (2n = 2x = 18). We performed a cross between a sexual and an apomictic individual (pollen donor), generated haplotype-resolved genome assemblies for the two parents, and deep-sequenced 226 progeny. These data were integrated into a graph pangenome to characterize the meiotic recombination landscape. The apomictic lineage harbors 1.28-fold more heterozygous structural variations, which may locally suppress crossovers. Furthermore, apomictic recombination efficiency is reduced by 24.2% relative to the sexual lineage. Crucially, the contribution of male function through outcrossing exposes a substantial recessive genetic load, including a putative gamete-lethal mutation, triggering significant segregation distortion across 31.7% of the genome. We established that these distortion profiles are driven by the cumulative effects of multiple loci, with the magnitude of distortion depending on haplotype interactions. Collectively, our study quantifies the recombination landscape of apomixis and provides a framework for unmasking and mitigating genetic load in asexual crops.

摘要

有性生殖通过重组促进有害突变的清除。无融合生殖，定义为无性种子形成，涉及减数分裂受到抑制，从而降低纯化选择的效力。然而，无融合生殖的演化后果仍知之甚少。在本研究中，我们使用野生柑橘（Citrus hindsii）作为二倍体遗传系统（2n = 2x = 18），其同时具有有性和无融合生殖（不定胚生殖）谱系。我们将一个有性个体与一个无融合生殖个体（花粉供体）杂交，为两个亲本生成了单倍型解析的基因组组装，并对 226 个子代进行了深度测序。这些数据被整合到图形泛基因组中，以表征减数分裂重组图谱。无融合生殖谱系携带多 1.28 倍的杂合结构变异，这可能在局部抑制交叉。此外，相对于有性谱系，无融合生殖的重组效率降低了 24.2%。关键的是，通过异交实现的雄性功能贡献暴露了大量的隐性遗传负荷，包括一个推测的配子致死突变，引发覆盖基因组 31.7%的显著分离畸变。我们确认，这些畸变谱由多个位点的累积效应驱动，畸变幅度取决于单倍型相互作用。总之，我们的研究量化了无融合生殖的重组图谱，并提供了一个框架，用于揭示和减轻无性作物中的遗传负荷。

item.title: Latent causal diffusions for single-cell perturbation modeling | 用于单细胞扰动建模的潜在因果扩散
item.description:
Abstract

Perturbation screens hold the potential to systematically map regulatory processes at single-cell resolution, yet modeling and predicting transcriptome-wide responses to perturbations remains a major computational challenge. Existing methods often underperform simple baselines, fail to disentangle measurement noise from biological signal, and provide limited insight into the causal structure governing cellular responses. Here, we present the latent causal diffusion (LCD), a generative model that frames single-cell gene expression as a stationary diffusion process observed under measurement noise. LCD outperforms established approaches in predicting the distributional shifts of unseen perturbation combinations in single-cell RNA-sequencing screens while simultaneously learning a mechanistic dynamical system of gene regulation. To interpret these learned dynamics, we develop an approach we call causal linearization via perturbation responses (CLIPR), which yields an approximation of the direct causal effects between all genes modeled by the diffusion. CLIPR provably identifies causal effects under a linear drift assumption and recovers causal structure in both simulated systems and a genome-wide perturbation screen, where it clusters genes into coherent functional modules and resolves causal relationships that standard differential expression analysis cannot. The LCD-CLIPR framework bridges generative modeling with causal inference to predict unseen perturbation effects and map the underlying regulatory mechanisms of the transcriptome.

摘要

扰动筛选有潜力在单细胞分辨率下系统性地绘制调控过程，但对全转录组范围的扰动响应进行建模和预测仍是一项重大计算挑战。现有方法常常不如简单基线，无法将测量噪声与生物信号解耦，并且对支配细胞响应的因果结构提供的洞见有限。在此，我们提出潜在因果扩散（latent causal diffusion, LCD），这是一种生成模型，将单细胞基因表达建模为在测量噪声下观测到的平稳扩散过程。LCD 在预测单细胞 RNA 测序筛选中未见扰动组合的分布偏移方面优于已有方法，同时学习基因调控的机制性动力系统。为了解释这些学到的动力学，我们开发了一种称为通过扰动响应的因果线性化（causal linearization via perturbation responses, CLIPR）的方法，它给出扩散所建模的所有基因之间直接因果效应的近似。CLIPR 可证明地在线性漂移假设下识别因果效应，并在模拟系统和全基因组扰动筛选中恢复因果结构；在此它把基因聚类为连贯的功能模块，并解析出标准差异表达分析无法解决的因果关系。LCD-CLIPR 框架连接生成建模与因果推断，以预测未见扰动效应并绘制转录组的潜在调控机制。

Journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
